srList.sentence: Histological and immunohistochemical analyses Paraffin-embedded mouse liver blocks were cut into sections of 5 mm thickness and stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) andor stained for F480 expression with rabbit anti-F480 antibodies (1:100) (AbD Serotec, Raleigh, NC, USA). 6,23 The fraction of F480-expressing cells for each sample is calculated as the sum of the number of nuclei of F480-expressing cells divided by the total number of nuclei in sections of a sample.
